basic_info.description: Great opportunity to restore this stately completely detached Forest Hill home, circa 1924. Outstanding floor plan. Main floor has an inviting foyer, a formal dining room, large living room, spacious kitchen, breakfast room, laundry room and half bath. Beautiful staircase leads to upstairs level which features four bedrooms & two full baths. Fourth bedroom in front has a balcony. Garage can accommodate 2 cars, has plenty of storage and also has a workshop/storage room. Landscaped back yard with fruit trees and rose bush. Fabulous location--walk to West Portal shops, restaurants, coffee shops, schools and transportation.
